== Course of events ==

After carrying the sleeping Dorothy clear of the poppy field, the travelers reach a river and cross it upon a raft built by the Tin Woodman, only for the current to catch the raft and sweep it off course. As the Scarecrow works to push the raft along, his pole sticks fast in the riverbed. Unable to pull it free in time, he is left behind as the raft drifts onward without him, stranding him alone in the middle of the river, still clinging to the lodged pole.
